key_insight: Combining neural-network phase-equilibrium predictions with adaptive tabulation accelerates thermodynamic calculations while avoiding fragile iterative VLE solves.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports stable, scalable simulations of high-pressure transcritical multiphase flows relevant to advanced propulsion.
method: Use a pretrained ANN for phase-equilibrium evaluations during ISAT table expansion.
Retrieve tabulated states rapidly through local linear interpolation.
Redistribute tasks with an O(N) greedy load balancer and integrate adaptive mesh refinement.
evidence_signal: On a Mach 5 shock–droplet benchmark, the abstract reports accurate shock–interface dynamics without instability, thermodynamic speedups of 2.30× on one core and 2.62× in parallel versus standalone ANNs, plus a separate 2.92× overall efficiency boost from AMR.
watch_item: Validation is reported for one benchmark; accuracy and stability beyond the ANN training domain require further assessment.
paper_title: Load-Balanced Neural-Network-Aided Adaptive Tabulation of Phase Equilibria for Transcritical Multiphase Flows
